correctness.rationale: Exact basis P_l^m(cos s) times cos(m phi), sin(m phi); their distinct vanishing orders at the pole prove independence. The restriction to a meridian is a dimension-(ell+1) trigonometric space with frequencies ell,ell-2,...,-ell. The ell+1 half-circle Fourier nodes are unisolvent. Odd modes vanish at the shared polar node, making both A and B nonsingular. The full evaluation matrix has block upper (A,0), lower (C_theta,B diag(sin(m theta))), yielding the determinant and exact nullity. gcd rational denominator count, exact blind-mode basis and the linear singular crossings follow. verify.py checks 98 finite cases; it does not substitute for proof.

value.rationale: A complete exact interpolation design for every pure-degree spherical Laplace eigenspace using only \(2\ell+1\) points on two meridians, including a sharp rational-angle failure classification and full angular determinant factorization. The result provides usable geometric sensor placement and an explicit order-of-vanishing stability warning; it is more than a generic rank assertion or finite numerical table. It does not extend to arbitrary mixed degrees or uniform conditioning.
